accepted.quote: H.R. 1048 would pile on unnecessary and unmeaningful requirements that will make it harder for institutions to comply with Section 117, ignoring the significant strides taken by the Biden Administration to align research security protocols across federal agencies.
accepted.rationale: The quote opposes H.R. 1048 because its additional Section 117 requirements would hinder institutional compliance.
